ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of every direct shareholder, ultimate beneficial owner (defined as any individual directly or indirectly holding 25% or more of charter capital or voting rights, or exercising control through other means), director, and legal representative against: (i) the State Bank of Viet Nam's domestic AML blacklist/watchlist under Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN; (ii) the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List and OFAC consolidated sanctions list (de facto enforced by licensed Vietnamese banks on cross-border wire and Wise B2B rails); (iii) the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (iv) the UK HM Treasury consolidated sanctions list and (v) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list. Enhanced Due Diligence under Article 8 of Law No. 14/2022/QH15 is triggered upon identification of any Politically Exposed Person — foreign PEP, domestic prominent public functionary, or international-organization PEP — including family members and close associates, requiring senior-management sign-off, source-of-funds documentation, and intensified ongoing transaction monitoring. Negative news and adverse-media screening against the World Bank sanctioned entities list and FATF statements is also applied. All screening results must be preserved in the pre-incorporation AML file for at least five years per Decree 05/2019/ND-CP.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Registration Information System / Business Registration Portal (Cổng đăng ký doanh nghiệp quốc gia) at dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn, operated by the Business Registration Agency of the Ministry of Planning and Investment; application dossiers are submitted online or in person to the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the intended head-office province (e.g., Ho Chi Minh City DPI or Hanoi DPI).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Articles 38–40 of Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Articles 12–16 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP require the enterprise name to be written in the Vietnamese alphabet (Quốc ngữ); the name may contain letters A–Z/a–z, digits 0–9, and the permitted symbols '&', '.', '-', '+' and ':' provided it comprises at least two elements followed by the legal-form suffix 'Công ty TNHH' (or 'LLC' for the English-inclusive formulation). A foreign-invested LLC may additionally hold a foreign-language name transliterated into Vietnamese phonetic script; the transliteration must be a faithful and recognizable rendering of the foreign name and must not be identical or confusingly similar to any previously registered enterprise. Names must not be identical to the reserved/protected name of an existing enterprise, must not misrepresent the legal form, and must not violate national sovereignty, historical or cultural traditions, or national ethics.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Viet Nam / Việt Nam (requires approval of the competent regulatory authority for use in enterprise names)
Bank / Ngân hàng (requires State Bank of Viet Nam prior approval)
Insurance / Bảo hiểm (requires Ministry of Finance prior approval)
Securities / Chứng khoán (requires State Securities Commission prior approval)
Investment Fund / Quỹ đầu tư (requires financial-regulator prior approval)
Credit Union / Quỹ tín dụng (requires State Bank prior approval)
Gambling / Casino (requires Ministry of Finance prior licensing approval)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Viet Nam does not operate a standalone name-reservation mechanism; name clearance is effected through the enterprise-registration dossier itself. Upon submission, the DPI has 3 working days to issue the Enterprise Registration Certificate or a written rejection stating the exact ground for refusal (Article 26, Decree 01/2021/ND-CP). If the name is rejected, the applicant may within 30 calendar days correct the name and resubmit an amended dossier, or file a formal administrative appeal with the provincial Department of Planning and Investment or, hierarchically, with the Business Registration Agency of the Ministry of Planning and Investment under the Law on Handling of Administrative Violations No. 15/2012/QH13 (as amended). If the administrative appeal is denied, the applicant may initiate an administrative lawsuit before the competent Provincial People's Court under the Law on Administrative Procedure No. 93/2015/QH13 within one year of the rejection decision. In practice, name-refusal appeals succeed most often where the rejected token was merely 'confusingly similar' rather than 'identical'; the applicant is advised to obtain a prior informal availability check on the portal and to maintain two alternates in the same filing to avoid delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally Permissible — Article 43 of Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 requires every enterprise to maintain a head office physically located on Vietnamese territory, with a complete address capable of receiving service of process and official correspondence. For a low-risk market-entry consultancy (ISIC 7020), a licensed virtual-office service offering a physical suite or serviced desk, mail handling, and a DPI-registered address is accepted for business-registration purposes, provided a valid office-lease or serviced-office agreement covering the entire registration term exists and the address is not located in a pure residential zone. Moderate substance risk remains: the General Department of Taxation may examine the place of actual management for corporate income tax residency, and banks onboarding the Vietnamese LLC may independently verify physical signage and a lease table upon account opening.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (10–15% likelihood within the first 12 months of operation). The DPI may conduct post-registration verification at the registered head office under Articles 201–204 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP, and tax authorities may perform unannounced physical inspections where VAT, corporate income tax, or cross-border payment anomalies are flagged. For a no-statutory-licence consultancy with 'Low_Risk_Standard' AML classification and bank-wire/Wise-only payment rails, unannounced on-site inspection risk is correspondingly minimal.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 dated 17 June 2020, effective 1 January 2021, Articles 26 to 28 (enterprise registration dossier, issuance of Enterprise Registration Certificate), Articles 46 to 58 (multi-member limited liability companies), Articles 73 to 80 (single-member limited liability companies), Articles 133 to 137 (legal representation and corporate seal); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 33 to 38 (investment registration for foreign investors); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration, including Forms I-1 and III-1; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP detailing the Law on Investment, including Form A-I; Circular No. 05/2021/TT-NHNN of the State Bank of Vietnam governing foreign direct investment capital accounts.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office and Investment Registration Division of the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally governed city where the head office is located, operating through the National Enterprise Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) and the national public service portal (dichvucong.gov.vn).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration for a limited liability company (Form I-1 for a one-member LLC, or Form III-1 for a multi-member LLC) filed together with the Charter and the list of members; the foreign investor must first or simultaneously submit a Written Proposal of the Investment Project and an Application for Investment Registration (Form A-I under Decree 31/2021/ND-CP) for issuance of the Investment Registration Certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum charter capital applies to ISIC 7020 management consultancy under Vietnamese law; market-entry consulting is not a conditional business line and is not subject to the legal capital requirements of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP. The founders freely determine the charter capital in the corporate charter. However, under Articles 47 and 75 of the Law on Enterprises 2020, the member or members must fully pay the registered charter capital within 90 days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate; unpaid capital triggers a mandatory reduction of charter capital to the paid-up amount. For a foreign-invested LLC, the equity contribution must be remitted by wire transfer in VND to the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) opened at a licensed commercial bank in Vietnam pursuant to Circular No. 05/2021/TT-NHNN; no escrow account is statutorily required, but the DICA is monitored by the State Bank of Vietnam and the bank must issue a capital-contribution receipt evidenced by the incoming remittance.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE MEMBER / FIRST MEETING OF MEMBERS of [FULL VIETNAMESE COMPANY NAME] (the Company), a foreign-invested limited liability company to be incorporated under the laws of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, adopted on [date] at [place] by the undersigned member(s). WHEREAS the Company is to be formed under the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 for the purpose of carrying out ISIC 7020 activities, namely overseas market-entry consultancy, regulatory advisory and feasibility studies, all being unlicensed, non-conditional services; NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS RESOLVED: 1. NAME AND FORM: the Company shall adopt the registered name set out in the Charter, together with its international name [COMPANY ENGLISH NAME] and abbreviated name, and shall take the legal form of a limited liability company with separate legal personality, whose owners/members bear liability only to the extent of their contributed capital. 2. CHARTER CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION: the charter capital of the Company is fixed at VND [____] (in words), subscribed and agreed to be contributed by the sole member/each member in the proportions set out in the List of Members and the Charter; each contribution shall be paid in cash in VND by wire transfer to the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) of the Company at a licensed commercial bank in Vietnam within 90 days of the Enterprise Registration Certificate; if any capital is not paid on time, the charter capital shall be reduced to the actually paid amount and the Charter shall be amended in accordance with Articles 47 and 75 of the Law on Enterprises. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE: the registered office of the Company is adopted as [Full address: No., street, ward, district, province or city, Vietnam], which shall be the venue of the Company's management and statutory records. 4. LEGAL REPRESENTATIVE AND OFFICERS: [Name, passport number, date of birth, nationality] is appointed President of the Company (Chairman) and [Name, passport number, date of birth, nationality] is appointed General Director; the Chairman and the General Director shall each have authority to act as legal representative of the Company in accordance with Article 12 of the Law on Enterprises, provided that at least one legal representative resides in Vietnam during the term of office; the General Director shall have day-to-day management authority and shall exercise the powers prescribed in the Charter and this Resolution. 5. CORPORATE SEAL: the Company shall adopt a corporate seal conforming to Article 137 of the Law on Enterprises; the General Director is authorized to procure the seal, to maintain the seal-use register and to notify the seal specimen to the bank and counterparties. 6. FILING AND REGISTRATION AUTHORITY: the Chairman and the General Director, or either of them, are hereby authorized to prepare, notarize, sign and submit the investment registration dossier to the Investment Registration Division of the DPI and the enterprise registration dossier to the Business Registration Office of the DPI, online or in person, and to receive the Investment Registration Certificate and the Enterprise Registration Certificate, with power to delegate through a notarized power of attorney. 7. BANK MANDATE: the DICA and operating bank accounts shall be opened at an SBV-licensed bank, with signature mandate as set in the account application and bank resolution of the Company. 8. POST-REGISTRATION COMPLIANCE: the officers shall file business-licence tax declarations, social insurance registration, labour-use registration and any other statutory disclosures at the tax authority, the Social Insurance Agency and the Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs as applicable. 9. EFFECTIVENESS: this Resolution is effective from the date of adoption; certified copies of this Resolution shall be attached to the incorporation dossier and delivered to the bank and the relevant authorities. RESOLVED AND ADOPTED on [date] by the member(s) as evidenced by the signatures below.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-submission name search and corporate charter drafting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Enterprise Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) for name availability verification; drafting by the investor and licensed local counsel.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founders identify a proposed Vietnamese enterprise name which must include the legal-form appellation CÔNG TY TNHH or CÔNG TY TRÁCH NHIỆM HỮU HẠN, followed by a proper name. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing or recently dissolved enterprise name on the National Enterprise Registration Information System, must not be prohibited under Articles 38 to 42 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP, and must avoid names of state agencies or armed forces. In parallel, a draft Charter is prepared containing the name, address, charter capital, members and contribution schedule, legal representatives, business lines limited to ISIC 7020 consultancy, capital transfer rules, and internal governance of the LLC.
required_dossiers: Proposed Vietnamese, English and abbreviated company names
Draft Company Charter in Vietnamese
Passport or corporate certificate of incorporation of each proposed member
Passport of each proposed legal representative and General Director
Power of attorney from the foreign investor to the local filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or deemed conflicting, the applicant selects an alternative name and refiles; the registry usually issues a written or portal-based notice specifying the conflicting name within 3 working days, and resubmission of a corrected application cures the defect without penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) application for the foreign investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Registration Division of the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or city of the head office, via the one-stop-shop or the national public service portal (dichvucong.gov.vn).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Because the project is a foreign-invested LLC established in a non-conditional sector without state land allocation or state-guaranteed incentives, it requires an Investment Registration Certificate under Articles 33 to 38 of the Law on Investment 2020. The investor submits Form A-I (Written Proposal of Investment Project) together with its certificate of incorporation, audited financial statements or bank evidence of financial capacity, the resolution of the foreign parent company authorizing the Vietnamese project, the draft project charter, and the delegation of authority. The DPI verifies the legal status of the investor, the legality of the business line, and the capital commitment method, then issues the IRC within the statutory review period.
required_dossiers: Form A-I: Written Proposal of Investment Project and Application for Investment Registration
Certificate of incorporation or business registration certificate of the foreign investor, consular legalized or apostilled and translated into Vietnamese
Most recent audited financial statements or a bank credit certificate evidencing the financial capacity of the foreign investor
Board resolution or shareholders' resolution of the foreign investor approving the establishment of the Vietnamese LLC, the charter capital and the legal representative
Power of attorney appointing the person to submit and receive the dossier
Copy of the passport of the proposed statutory legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is incomplete, the DPI issues a written request for supplementation, usually within 5 working days; the applicant cures the dossier by resubmitting the missing item. If the IRC is refused, the investor may appeal to the provincial People's Committee under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13 within 30 days, or may re-file a corrected application after remedying the stated grounds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office of the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) through the National Enterprise Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the IRC is granted, the founders submit the enterprise registration dossier for the LLC under Article 26 of the Law on Enterprises 2020. The dossier is filed online at dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn with digital signatures of the legal representatives, followed by hard-copy submission if required by the local DPI. The Business Registration Office examines the company name, charter, members, legal representatives, capital contribution ratio, and registered address. Upon approval, the ERC is issued electronically and paper-based, and the tax identification number is granted automatically on the same certificate.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration Form I-1 (one-member LLC) or Form III-1 (multi-member LLC)
Valid Investment Registration Certificate (IRC)
Company Charter signed by all members or by the legal representative of the sole member
List of members, including full name, nationality, passport number, residential address and capital ratio of each member
Certified copies of the legal standing documents of members (passport or certificate of incorporation with apostille/consular legalization and notarized Vietnamese translation)
Certificate of registered-office address, being either a lease agreement with the owner's written consent or a certificate of land use rights with the consent of the owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Under Article 28 of the Law on Enterprises, if the dossier is invalid, the Business Registration Office must state the amendment points in writing within 3 working days; the applicant corrects and resubmits without losing priority. If the ERC issuance is refused, the applicant may appeal to the provincial People's Committee under Law No. 02/2011/QH13 or initiate an administrative lawsuit under Law No. 93/2015/QH13 within the applicable limitation period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate seal creation, seal-use register and publication of enterprise information
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Seal engraving enterprise of the company's choice; no state authorization or seal registration is required under Article 137 of the Law on Enterprises 2020; the enterprise record is publicly displayed on the National Enterprise Registration Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the ERC is issued, the Company procures a corporate seal in the preferred design and shall manage the seal under the seal-use register, recording each use with the name of the authorized signatory, document reference, date, and purpose. The seal does not need to be reported to the Business Registration Office. Specimens of the seal and signatures are then certified at the bank where the DICA and operating accounts are opened, and the seal specimen is provided to the tax authority upon request.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
Charter and certificate of registered office address
Passport and appointment resolution of the General Director
Seal-use register template and internal seal policy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a counterparty or bank queries the seal specimen, the Company certifies the specimen by its legal representative with a copy of the ERC; if the seal engraving company raises documentation concerns, the Company supplies the notarized copy of the ERC and the Charter. Because seal registration is abolished, no cure before the registry is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) opening and charter capital contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank in Vietnam as the reporting agent of the State Bank of Vietnam, pursuant to Circular No. 05/2021/TT-NHNN.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Company opens a Direct Investment Capital Account in VND at a chosen licensed bank and notifies the bank of the incoming equity contribution. The foreign investor remits the charter capital by wire transfer with a purpose code indicating 'direct investment capital contribution', converting foreign currency into VND at the trading rate of the receiving bank. The bank credits the DICA, issues a certificate of inward foreign direct investment, and reports the transaction to the State Bank of Vietnam. The capital must be fully contributed within 90 days of the ERC date; the bank's receipt evidences compliance for the financial statements and the annual SBV reporting.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate (originals for verification)
Company Charter
Corporate seal specimen and signature mandate forms
Resolution of the Company appointing the bank signatories
Identity documents of the ultimate beneficial owner and signatories for KYC and AML purposes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank returns or rejects the remittance due to a missing or incorrect purpose code, the investor re-remits with the correct DICA instruction and the code for equity contribution; if the bank requires enhanced due diligence, the Company supplies a UBO declaration, the ERC, the Charter and the capital schedule. Where a bank error causes misposting, the Company submits a written correction request with the remittance advice, and, failing resolution, lodges a complaint with the State Bank of Vietnam's supervision branch.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration, business-licence tax, labour and social insurance registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Department of Taxation and the provincial Tax Department; Viet Nam Social Security; Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The tax identification number is granted automatically upon issuance of the ERC; the Company then activates its tax profile at the provincial Tax Department through the e-tax portal (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn). The Company files the business-licence tax declaration (lệ phí môn bài) within 30 days of ERC issuance; newly established enterprises are exempt from business-licence tax for the first year, but must still file the declaration. The Company registers its employees with Viet Nam Social Security for compulsory social, health and unemployment insurance within 30 days of signing labour contracts, and submits the labour-use declaration to DOLISA. Where the Company has 10 or more employees, a written internal labour regulation must be registered with DOLISA.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate containing the tax identification number
Company Charter and corporate seal specimen
Certified copy of the lease agreement for the registered office
Labour contracts and employee identification documents for social insurance registration
Internal labour regulation (if 10 or more employees)
Business-licence tax declaration form (Form 01/MBAI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax profile cannot be activated electronically, the legal representative attends the Tax Department in person with the ERC and charter; if the business-licence tax filing deadline is missed, the Company files late with an explanatory letter and pays the administrative fine under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP, then maintains compliance; social insurance or DOLISA queries are cured by resubmitting the labour list and corrected forms within the deadline stated in the written request.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for ISIC 7020 management consultancy; no industrial licensing board intervenes. Office construction and building safety are governed by the Ministry of Construction and the provincial Department of Construction, while fire safety is enforced by the Fire Prevention and Rescue Police Department of the provincial Public Security; these authorities act only through the building owner or in periodic inspections of the leased office.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sector-specific operating licence is required. The Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) issued under the Law on Enterprises 2020 is the sole operating permit for overseas market-entry consulting services; the activity is not listed among conditional business lines under Appendix IV of the Law on Investment 2020 nor under Decree 01/2021/ND-CP.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) and the provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from EIA and environmental permitting. Office-based consultancy does not fall within the project categories requiring an EIA report or environmental permit under Article 30 and Annex II of the Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP; no environmental registration is required where the premises are leased within a commercial building with centralized waste collection, and domestic waste is handled by the building operator.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to a consultancy with no production or manufacturing process. Where the office discharges domestic wastewater, compliance with QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT through the building's centralized sewage system is required; ambient air quality within the office must not violate QCVN 06:2009/BTNMT; electronic and office waste is classified as municipal solid waste and must be transferred to licensed collectors under Article 77 of Law No. 72/2020/QH14 and Decree 08/2022/ND-CP; the project generates no VOCs, industrial effluent or hazardous waste, hence no discharge threshold applies.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: the building owner must hold the fire protection design appraisal and fire safety acceptance certificate under Decree 136/2020/ND-CP covering the leased premises; the tenant must comply with the building's fire safety plan, maintain escape routes, provide fire extinguishers on each floor, and conduct annual fire drills and self-inspection records under Decree 136/2020/ND-CP. Occupational safety: the Company must comply with the Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13 by providing workplace induction and safety training, establishing a safety inspection book, and arranging periodic health checks for employees; no prior physical-clearance certificate is required for rented office use, but the annual fire-safety inspection by the Fire Prevention and Rescue Police is mandatory and can result in temporary suspension of activity until remedial measures are completed.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế) under the Ministry of Finance; official portal: etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested limited liability company obtains its tax identification number (Mã số thuế) automatically upon successful enterprise registration with the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI). No separate TIN application is required for the entity itself. The LLC must then register for VAT, e-invoice issuance, and periodic tax declarations on the General Department of Taxation's electronic portal. Foreign contractors or suppliers without a local entity are subject to a separate registration and withholding process under Vietnamese tax law.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnam does not provide a check-the-box entity classification regime. A Vietnamese LLC is always treated as a separate corporate taxpayer for Corporate Income Tax (CIT) purposes. Certain elective regimes exist for investment incentives (e.g., high-tech enterprise status, export processing enterprise status), for accounting basis (accrual vs. cash in exceptional thresholds), and for foreign tax relief (election to claim a foreign tax credit instead of a deduction for foreign taxes paid). Hybrid mismatch elections are not locally available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None for LLCs; all enterprises, including foreign-invested LLCs, must register and file VAT regardless of turnover. A VND 100,000,000 annual revenue threshold applies only to household businesses and individuals, not to LLCs.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT invoices must be issued as electronic invoices through the General Department of Taxation's e-invoice system (xml format), bearing a unique digital signature. For invoices requiring the tax authority's code, the XML data must be transmitted to the GDT portal in real-time before issuance; the GDT approves and affixes a tax authority code within 30 minutes. For enterprises permitted to issue e-invoices without a tax code, the XML files must still be transmitted to the tax authority within a prescribed period. No physical stamping is required; digital authentication via GDT's system is mandatory.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Consultancy and other exportable services qualify for the 0% VAT rate under Article 1 of Circular 130/2016/TT-BTC (amending Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC) when all of the following conditions are satisfied: (i) the service is supplied directly to a foreign organization or individual under a written service contract; (ii) the foreign recipient has no permanent establishment in Vietnam; and (iii) the service is physically and legally consumed outside Vietnam. For an overseas market entry consultancy paid by a non-resident client, the 0% rate applies if the service is provided from Vietnam to an offshore customer and the out-of-Vietnam consumption condition is duly documented. The provider must retain the export service contract, correspondence, payment evidence, and any supporting deliverables confirming the offshore consumption.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (for goods; not directly applicable to pure services but required when accompanying software or documents in physical form)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing shipment of any tangible goods or deliverables to overseas recipient
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank statement demonstrating non-cash payment received from abroad through a licensed Vietnamese bank
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are intensely scrutinized by the Vietnamese tax authority. If the statutory documentation is incomplete, if the overseas payment is not received within the 180-day repatriation deadline, or if the claimed export service is deemed to have been consumed in Vietnam, the tax authority will: (i) reverse the 0% VAT treatment and re-assess standard 10% VAT on the full export revenue; (ii) disallow any corresponding input VAT credit; (iii) impose late-payment interest at 0.03% per day; (iv) apply administrative fines for tax evasion of up to 3 times the tax evaded; and (v) refer the matter for criminal prosecution if intentional fraud is established. Additionally, the exporter's e-invoice blocks may be suspended, and the enterprise may be placed on the 'high-risk' list for future customs and tax audits.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV; Vietnamese: Ngan hang Nha nuoc Viet Nam). Foreign exchange administration is exercised by the SBV under the Foreign Exchange Ordinance No. 28/2005/PL-UBTVQH11, Decree No. 70/2014/ND-CP, and implementing circulars, notably Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN (as amended by Circular No. 03/2018/TT-NHNN) for current account transactions, Circular No. 19/2014/TT-NHNN for the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) regime applicable to foreign-invested enterprises, and Circular No. 05/2021/TT-NHNN (as amended by Circular No. 01/2024/TT-NHNN) for foreign loan registration and repayment. The SBV also administers Decree No. 88/2019/ND-CP for administrative sanctions in the foreign exchange and banking sphere.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vietnamese dong (VND) operates under a managed float and is not freely convertible. Current account transactions are broadly liberalized: payments and transfers for trade in goods and services, including consulting fees, royalties, interest, and the annual remittance of profits by foreign-invested enterprises, may be executed through authorized credit institutions upon production of underlying commercial documents and tax compliance evidence. Capital account convertibility is restricted. Inward foreign direct investment equity contributions and shareholder loans, and outward remittances of dividends, loan principal, and liquidation proceeds, must pass through a registered Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) maintained at an SBV-licensed bank. Profit remittance hurdles include the completion of the annual statutory audit, finalization of corporate income tax (CIT) liabilities, settlement of all Foreign Contractor Tax and social insurance obligations, a resolution of the Members Council approving the dividend distribution, and the practical availability of distributable retained earnings as confirmed by the auditor. No additional dividend withholding tax is imposed under domestic law on a Vietnamese LLC distributing profits to a corporate shareholder, but the bank requires the certified DICA documentation, and the payment is reviewed against the reported tax position. The ordinary timeliness risk is approximately one to four weeks per remittance cycle; notification to the local tax authority of the remittance plan is required by practice.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters of goods and services, including the consulting services performed by this LLC for overseas clients, must repatriate export proceeds into a foreign currency account maintained at a licensed credit institution in Vietnam within 90 days from the date of export or completion of the service, pursuant to Decree No. 70/2014/ND-CP; an extension to 180 days may be granted by the managing bank for justifiable commercial reasons. Vietnam abolished mandatory export surrender ratios for ordinary exporters in the post-2015 liberalization: there is currently no fixed statutory percentage of export receipts that must be converted into VND, and exporters may retain 100% of export proceeds in foreign currency. In the event the enterprise requires VND for domestic operating expenses, conversion is executed at the authorized bank's spot rate. The bank reconciles export proceeds against customs declarations, service agreements, and invoices, and the SBV retains the authority to re-impose compulsory surrender at specified percentages during balance-of-payments emergency conditions, although no such ratio is presently in force.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.capital_account_opening_requirement: Every foreign-invested LLC must open a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) with an authorized bank upon issuance of the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), and all charter capital contributions, foreign loan drawdowns, profit repatriations, and liquidation proceeds in foreign currency must be routed through the DICA. The DICA may be maintained in VND or a permitted foreign currency, and operational current account balances for ordinary business expenses are held in separate VND and foreign currency operating accounts linked to the DICA.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietcombank - Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) plus Operational VND and USD/EUR accounts with integrated SWIFT corporate banking and trade finance

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BIDV - Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: DICA plus Operational VND and foreign currency accounts; strong state-cooperation and SBV relationship network

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: VietinBank - Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Industry and Trade
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: DICA plus Operational VND and foreign currency accounts; experienced in foreign-invested enterprise structuring and export service receivables

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Techcombank - Vietnam Technological and Commercial Joint Stock Bank
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational VND and foreign currency accounts with best-in-class digital banking; DICA support available, though primary FDI onboarding expertise is less concentrated than at the three state-linked leaders

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: MB Bank - Military Commercial Joint Stock Bank
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational accounts and trade finance; DICA opening supported for low-risk service enterprises with simplified documentation

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for primary banking and DICA purposes; MEDIUM-LOW as a supplementary collection or disbursement rail for low-value overseas payments. Offshore digital payment institutions (Wise Business, Airwallex, Revolut Business, Payoneer) do not hold a State Bank of Vietnam license under the Law on Credit Institutions 2024 or Decree No. 101/2012/ND-CP, as amended by Decree No. 80/2016/ND-CP, and therefore cannot open VND settlement accounts, act as the Direct Investment Capital Account bank, or lawfully provide domestic payment services to a Vietnamese LLC. Funds that are receivable by the LLC may be collected through an offshore EMI in limited circumstances, but such receipts must be swept into the licensed onshore DICA or the operating account within the 90-day repatriation window to avoid an administrative sanction under Decree No. 88/2019/ND-CP and to satisfy the bank's underlying-documentation review. Vietnamese commercial banks may treat credits originating from EMIs as third-party or unexplained flows and request additional declarations, source-of-fund confirmation, and copies of the service contract before accepting the funds.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person appearance is the prevailing statutory and supervisory norm for corporate account opening in Vietnam. The legal representative of the LLC (General Director or Chairman of the Members Council) must appear at the bank branch in Vietnam on initial onboarding for identity verification and execution of the account agreement; where the legal representative is located offshore, a notarized Power of Attorney appointing an onshore authorized representative is accepted by most tier-one banks but the underlying KYC interview still occurs in person at the branch. The chief accountant may also be required to appear and co-sign for the opening of operational accounts. Remote or fully digital corporate onboarding is not generally available under Circular No. 17/2024/TT-NHNN on payment accounts, which reserves electronic know-your-customer (eKYC) procedures for individual customers; a supplementary video interview may be used by some joint-stock banks after the physical visit, but the documentary baseline remains mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) identification failure: inability or unwillingness of the applicant to disclose natural persons holding 25% or more of the entity or exercising effective control, as required by the Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 and Decree No. 117/2023/ND-CP.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified group and shareholder structure chart showing each legal entity level through to the ultimate natural persons; completed UBO declaration forms for each 25%+ shareholder and each individual exercising management control; passport copies with notarized Vietnamese translation; share register and members list filed in the National Enterprise Registration Portal; certificate of incorporation and register of members of the offshore parent accompanied by an apostilled legal opinion from the home jurisdiction; source of wealth statement for each UBO explaining concentration of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of charter capital concern: the bank cannot verify the lawful origin of the funds that will be remitted from the offshore shareholder into the DICA of the Vietnamese LLC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements of the shareholder for the past two fiscal years evidencing accumulated retained earnings, or certified bank statement of the shareholder showing the specific liquidity pool; underlying dividend distribution resolutions, share purchase agreements, employment records and personal tax returns where an individual shareholder is involved; a notarized capital contribution schedule aligned to the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC); the board resolution authorizing the remittance; a written source-of-funds statement signed by the shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial control mismatch: the individual appointed as legal representative of the LLC is not the natural person named in the IRC or Enterprise Registration Certificate, or the corporate governance documentation does not reflect the actual decision-making chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Members Council or shareholders meeting minutes approving the appointment of the General Director or Chairman; written employment contract or appointment decision; current Enterprise Registration Certificate excerpt (Giay xac nhan dang ky doanh nghiep) listing the legal representative; notarized Power of Attorney delegating banking authority; passport of the appointee and, if applicable, passport copies of any co-signatories; a compliance statement identifying the beneficial owner's role in management.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax and regulatory clearance gap: absence of a good-standing certificate, outstanding Foreign Contractor Tax or CIT obligations, or failure to register tax obligations after incorporation, which is treated as an indicator of economic substance risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax registration certificate (Ma so thue) and latest confirmed tax status certificate issued by the local tax authority; filed CIT return and documentary evidence of tax payments for the most recent period; audited financial statements, if issued, accompanied by the audit firm's license; a statutory declaration that the LLC has not commenced revenue-generating activities and holds no unpaid tax liabilities; confirmation of the LLC's local business address and lease agreement evidencing physical presence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction purpose ambiguity: projected inbound and outbound flows of a market-entry consultancy do not correspond to the stated scope of the LLC, particularly where the LLC services foreign affiliates in the same corporate group.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master service agreement with the overseas client or group company; detailed statement of work outlining market feasibility studies, regulatory licensing support, and market-entry consulting deliverables; fee schedule and invoicing history or pro-forma invoices; professional biographies of the consulting staff; evidence of professional indemnity insurance; corporate brochure and website; a written explanation of the expected annual transaction volume and counterparty profile; entity economic substance documentation including local payroll and office lease.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All charter capital contributions and shareholder loans are remitted from the offshore investor's banking account via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 to the DICA of the Vietnamese LLC maintained at a licensed commercial bank. The SWIFT narrative (field 70) must expressly state the purpose of the remittance, referencing the full legal name of the LLC, the Investment Registration Certificate number, and the capital contribution schedule, for example: CONTRIBUTION OF CHARTER CAPITAL TO {LLC NAME} UNDER IRC NO. {XXX} DATED {DD/MM/YYYY}. The sending bank account name must exactly match the name of the foreign investor recorded in the IRC; nexus mismatches are the most frequent cause of quarantine by the compliance department of the receiving bank. Upon receipt, the bank credits the DICA and reports the inflow to the SBV's foreign exchange management information system, and may request the closing capital certificate or bank confirmation of the contribution to complete the IRC contribution milestone. Where the LLC receives a shareholder loan above the statutory threshold, a separate foreign loan registration must be obtained from the SBV via the authorized bank under Circular No. 05/2021/TT-NHNN before the drawdown is credited; short-term trade credit facilities under one year are exempt from registration but remain subject to bank verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Cross-border disbursements for consultancy operations, including payments to overseas subcontracting consultants, market research agencies, software and data platform subscriptions, licensing fees, and foreign marketing agents, are settled by SWIFT MT103 from the VND or USD operating account, or directly from the DICA where the payment relates to a registered capital item. Banks require the underlying service contract or invoice and a completed Foreign Contractor Tax withholding form (Form 01/NTNN under Circular No. 80/2021/TT-BTC) together with evidence of payment of the deemed VAT (5%) and CIT (5%) for pure consulting services before executing the remittance; alternative relief certificates under a double tax treaty must be filed with the tax authority to reduce the CIT component. Payments above the bank's regulatory threshold (USD 10,000 equivalent in most institutions) trigger enhanced documentary review. Where the LLC's scope expands to include procurement of equipment or goods for foreign clients, commercial letters of credit (MT700) may be issued at the same bank, with subsequent settlement via MT103 or MT202; domestic VND funding of the settlement account is executed through the National Payment Corporation of Vietnam's clearing house, ACH, or instant VietQR transfer, after which the foreign currency leg is effected through the bank's correspondent network (USD via CHIPS/Fedwire, EUR via TARGET2, and JPY via FXYCS/BOJ-NET).
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore FX Forward Contracts (VND/USD, VND/EUR) with a licensed credit institution, maximum tenor 365 days, supported by genuine underlying trade or service cash flows and registered capital payment obligations; the forward must be documented with the relevant contract and bank facility agreement.

Onshore FX Swaps (spot/forward combinations and forward/forward swaps) used for short-term liquidity rebalancing between VND and foreign currency where the LLC holds dual-currency operating positions, executed with the same licensed bank under the master FX agreement.

Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swaps (CIRS) for hedging long-term foreign-currency shareholder loans, permitted where the underlying loan has been registered with the State Bank of Vietnam pursuant to Circular No. 05/2021/TT-NHNN and the bank's credit approval contemplates the derivatives exposure.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.ndf_offshore_status: Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in VND are not permissible for onshore corporate customers; offshore VND NDF markets are not recognized or licensed by the State Bank of Vietnam, and entering into such structures without an underlying registered transaction exposes the LLC to administrative sanctions and reputational risk. Hedging discipline should therefore rely exclusively on deliverable onshore forwards and swaps with a licensed bank.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Report (annual corporate information statement)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment - Business Registration Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end; 31 March for calendar-year companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under Decree 50/2016/ND-CP, typically VND 2-5 million for late filing and VND 10-20 million for false statements; repeated or continuous non-filing can trigger formal warnings and administrative dissolution/removal from the national enterprise register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department, Department of Planning and Investment, and Provincial Statistical Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end; 31 March for calendar-year companies, with audit completed before submission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalties under Decree 41/2018/ND-CP for accounting and audit violations; failure to submit audited statements to the tax authority may lead to tax inspection, invoice-use suspension, and enforced collection measures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax finalization return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department of the General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than the 90th day after the end of the accounting year; 31 March for calendar-year taxpayers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest at 0.03% per day; late-filing fines up to VND 25 million; underpaid tax, penalties, and enforced collection may follow; persistent non-compliance may trigger invoice suspension and enterprise record deactivation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual personal income tax finalization return (withholding agent filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department of the General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than the 90th day after the calendar year-end; 31 March annually
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines up to VND 25 million, late-payment interest at 0.03% per day, and administrative penalties for incorrect withholding declarations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All foreign-invested LLCs, including the VN_LLC market-entry consultancy, are subject to mandatory independent annual audit regardless of revenue or total assets; no small-enterprise exemption applies to FDI entities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Viet Nam Accounting Standards (VAS) under Law on Accounting 88/2015/QH13, Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC, and Decree 17/2017/ND-CP; IFRS is not compulsory for standalone statutory financial statements of a non-listed LLC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Viet Nam has no standalone annual UBO return for standard LLCs. Ownership is evidenced by the Register of Members; all share/capital transfers must be notified to the Business Registration Office within 10 days of the change. The Annual Enterprise Report confirms current ownership/membership, and banks/KYC processes may require an updated UBO statement.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book for Members' Council meetings
Register of corporate resolutions and management decisions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 - 600 per annum for registered address and corporate compliance agent in major cities
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - 4,000 per annum for a small/medium consultancy LLC statutory audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% on taxable worldwide income derived through the Vietnamese limited liability company
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: ISIC 7020 (management and market-entry consultancy) does not qualify for statutory CIT holidays or preferential 10%/15% rates under Viet Nam’s Law on Enterprise Income Tax No. 14/2008/QH12, as amended. The standard 20% rate applies. Lower administrative burdens apply to SMES with annual revenue below VND 3 billion, but no reduced headline CIT rate is available for this scope.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Quarterly provisional Enterprise Income Tax return – Form 01/TNDN; e-filed via the General Department of Taxation portal (etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn) or the integrated nhantokhai.gdt.gov.vn electronic filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly (4 provisional filings per fiscal year).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than the 30th day of the first month following the close of each quarter. For a calendar-year taxpayer: Q1 by 30 April, Q2 by 30 July, Q3 by 30 October, Q4 by 30 January of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enterprise tax identification number (MST) and tax period indicator.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Vietnamese MST issued to the LLC. Do not substitute the foreign parent company’s tax identification number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from overseas market-entry consulting, regulatory licensing agency work, and related advisory services recognized in accordance with Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS), excluding output VAT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recognize fees on an accrual basis. If the fee is invoiced by an offshore affiliate and presented as a Vietnamese service, the Vietnamese entity must establish actual provision of services and cross-border tax exposure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costs directly attributable to generating the consulting revenue, evidenced by valid electronic invoices and vouchers, and within statutory deduction caps.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany management recharges must satisfy the arm’s-length principle and demonstrate economic substance; otherwise the tax authority may treat them as non-deductible and add back income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provisional revenue minus deductible expenses minus carried-forward losses (maximum 5 years).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses of foreign affiliates cannot be offset against Vietnamese-source profit. Only losses incurred by the Vietnamese LLC are available.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income multiplied by the standard 20% CIT rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-invested LLCs must pay all four quarterly provisional tranches, then reconcile against the annual finalization return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late e-filing: administrative warning or fine from VND 5,000,000 to VND 50,000,000. Late payment interest accrues at 0.03% per day on the unpaid CIT amount until fully settled.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual finalization CIT return – Form 03/TNDN; e-filed via etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn. Foreign-invested LLCs must attach audited financial statements and the annual related-party transaction disclosure under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than the 90th day following the end of the fiscal year (30 March for a calendar-year taxpayer).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box [02]/[03] – Tax period and taxpayer identification
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year, legal name, and TIN/MST of the Vietnamese LLC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact legal name and TIN stated in the Enterprise Registration Certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from overseas market-entry feasibility studies, regulatory licensing agency services, and related consultancy fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all revenue attributable to the Vietnamese legal entity irrespective of whether payment is collected in a foreign bank account; exclude output VAT on non-export services.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutorily exempt income (e.g., certain domestic dividends and government incentive receipts).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not classify consultancy fees as non-taxable; ISIC 7020 fees are ordinary taxable business revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses with valid e-invoices and contracts, below statutory deduction caps, and not prohibited by the CIT Law.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation for cross-border recharges; uncorroborated offshore invoices may be disallowed in full.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box D – Taxable income / loss carryforward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue less deductible expenses, then reduced by prior-year losses carried forward within the 5-year limit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No cross-border loss relief exists; only losses of the Vietnamese LLC may be applied to its own future profits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box E – CIT payable before incentives
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not claim CIT holidays unless the entity has a specific legal entitlement; general consulting activities are taxed at the standard rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box F – Net CIT payable / refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual CIT liability less all quarterly provisional payments already made.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any remaining CIT must be paid by 30 March before dividends or profits are repatriated.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fines from VND 5,000,000 to VND 50,000,000; false declaration: fine from 1 to 3 times the under-declared tax amount plus late-payment interest at 0.03% per day. Serious or repeated evasion is referred for criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% under Vietnam’s domestic law for dividends paid from after-tax profits to foreign corporate shareholders of a Vietnamese LLC. Vietnam does not impose a separate profit remittance tax on foreign investors. Remittance is permitted only after audited financial statements and the annual CIT finalization are completed and all tax liabilities are paid.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because domestic dividend withholding tax is 0%, submission of a Tax Residency Certificate is normally not required for Vietnamese dividend tax relief. The foreign shareholder should obtain a TRC from its own jurisdiction only to support a foreign tax credit or to verify treaty eligibility. If a bilateral DTA provides a reduced rate for a residual withholding-tax characterization, the non-resident investor must file an electronic treaty-relief application on the eTax portal, attach a valid TRC, and provide beneficial-ownership documentation and holding-period certification before the dividend remittance is processed.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Under the Foreign Contractor Tax regime (Circular 103/2014/TT-BTC), gross royalties paid to non-residents are subject to 10% FCT CIT (plus 5% FCT VAT where applicable); interest paid to non-resident lenders is subject to 5% FCT CIT. Tax treaties may reduce these rates (commonly 5–10% for interest and 10% for royalties) only when the recipient is the beneficial owner and provides a valid TRC. Related-party royalties and shareholder loans also remain subject to transfer-pricing review and thin-capitalization limits.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP, Local File documentation is exempt below: VND 30 billion of related-party transactions where the taxpayer’s annual revenue is below VND 50 billion; VND 50 billion where revenue is below VND 100 billion; and VND 100 billion where revenue is below VND 200 billion. Above these baskets, contemporaneous Local/Master File documentation is mandatory. Country-by-Country reporting applies to ultimate parent groups with consolidated revenue of at least VND 18,000 billion. Furthermore, an annual related-party transaction declaration must be submitted with Form 03/TNDN where related-party transaction value exceeds VND 1 billion.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Viet Nam does not apply a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations law, but the General Anti-Avoidance Rules and Decree 132/2020/ND-CP establish a substance-over-form doctrine. The tax authority may disregard transactions or entities lacking commercial substance, including shell LLCs with no employees, office premises, or local decision-making; round-tripped capital; or intercompany service fees with no demonstrable benefit. The taxpayer bears the burden of proving genuine economic substance and arm’s-length pricing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion and false CIT declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of consulting fees, concealment of foreign bank receipts, use of fabricated invoices, or classification of taxable consultancy income as exempt income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14: administrative penalty of 1 to 3 times the under-declared tax amount; late-payment interest at 0.03% per day; business registration cancellation for repeated serious violations. Criminal referral where evaded tax is at least VND 100 million; under Penal Code 2015 (as amended) fine up to VND 4.5 billion and/or imprisonment up to 7 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative or general director who personally certifies false returns faces criminal liability, civil restitution to the tax authority, prohibition from leaving Vietnam during investigation, and disqualification from acting as a director of any Vietnamese enterprise.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Underpricing cross-border market-entry consulting services, charging excessive offshore management fees, failing to file the annual related-party transaction declaration, or absence of contemporaneous Local/Master File documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may re-determine taxable income at arm’s length, impose additional CIT at 20%, charge late-payment interest of 0.03% per day, and issue administrative fines under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP for inadequate documentation, generally up to 20% of the underpaid tax (or higher where intentional distortion is proven).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who orchestrated artificial intercompany pricing, moved assets abroad, or instructed accountants to submit false TP disclosures are personally liable for unpaid taxes and may be prosecuted for tax evasion with asset freezes, travel bans, and custodial sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company and lack of economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a letterbox LLC with no Vietnamese employees, premises, or management autonomy; using nominee shareholders to conceal foreign control; booking contracts in Vietnam while all decisions are made offshore; and retaining profits offshore without substantive local business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: GAAR and Decree 132/2020/ND-CP allow the tax authority to disregard the entity and re-attribute revenue to the actual beneficial owner, resulting in additional CIT, back-withholding taxes, late-payment interest, fines, and revocation of enterprise registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil may be lifted under fraud and civil restitution principles. Directors involved in nominee arrangements face personal repayment orders, travel bans, criminal liability for falsifying enterprise registration documents, and prohibition from forming additional Vietnamese entities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Improper profit repatriation and false e-invoice schemes
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Remitting dividends before audited financial statements and final CIT returns are filed; distributing profits financed by unreported cash revenue; using false e-invoices to inflate deductible expenses and transfer hidden proceeds abroad through cross-border payment rails such as Wise B2B or bank wires.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority treats any unlawful remittance as undeclared taxable income, imposes additional CIT at 20% with late-payment interest, fines the taxpayer under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP, and blocks future profit remittance until all liabilities are discharged; criminal liability arises when false invoices are used to evade tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorize premature or fraudulent profit distributions are personally liable for restitution of funds, subject to exit-control/travel bans while under investigation, and may receive custodial sentences for tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing large cross-border wires without underlying enforceable consulting contracts, fragmenting payments across overseas bank accounts and e-wallet platforms, or failing to identify the ultimate beneficial owner of client funds despite a low-risk but regulated advisory business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Law on Anti-Money Laundering 2022 imposes administrative fines up to VND 3 billion for failure to conduct customer due diligence, maintain records, or report suspicious transactions; repeated violations may lead to business license suspension and referral for money-laundering prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Senior officers who knowingly facilitated layered transfers for third parties face criminal prosecution under Penal Code Article 324 for money laundering, with penalties including up to 15 years’ imprisonment, asset confiscation, travel bans, and lifetime disqualification from corporate management.
